description: The file defines an Android Fragment class 'ActiveNotificationsFragment' that manages notification interactions such as creating, grouping, and updating notifications on the status bar. It includes logic for adding notifications, generating summaries, and querying active notifications.

classes.name: ActiveNotificationsFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass that provides UI and logic for creating, managing, and displaying active notifications, including handling grouping and summaries.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates the number of notifications when the fragment resumes.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views and notification manager, sets up button click listener, and creates delete PendingIntent.

methods.name: addNotificationAndUpdateSummaries
methods.description: Creates a new notification and updates notification summaries.

methods.name: updateNotificationSummary
methods.description: Creates or clears the notification group summary based on active notifications.

methods.name: updateNumberOfNotifications
methods.description: Displays the current count of active notifications.

methods.name: getNewNotificationId
methods.description: Provides a unique ID for a new notification, ensuring no conflicts with the summary ID.

methods.name: getNumberOfNotifications
methods.description: Retrieves the current number of active notifications, excluding the summary if present.
